[Elven Knight Class Transfer]:
In order to become a Swordsinger, the Elven Knight must successfully complete three quests. The Trial of the Challenger can be undertaken by a player of level 35 or above. This quest begins by meeting with Kash of the Town of Dion. The Testimony of Life can only be undertaken by a player of level 37 or above. This quest begins by meeting with Master Cardien of the Town of Dion. Finally, the Test of the Duelist can be undertaken by a player of level 39 or above. This quest begins by meeting with Duelist Kaien of the Town of Oren.
[The Class Master]:
Rather than the quests, from level 40 you may visit the Class Master in Giran, next to the Arena. Clear his short trial, alone in a private hall, and he grants your new class at once.
